scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Fuel (Petrol) to the Fishermen for Operation of Out Board Motors
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession
Applicant must be a resident of Goa
Fishing canoe must be registered under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958
Applicant must be a member of the Registered Fisheries Co-operative Societies/Association or an individual
Applicant must not be a defaulter of the Directorate of Fisheries
Applicant must not be a violator of the Goa Daman & Diu Marine Fishing Regulation Act, 1980
Petrol out‑board motor (OBM) incorporated on the fishing vessel/canoe must be 10 HP or below
benefits_summary: ₹30 per litre subsidy on up to 1,000 L of petrol annually (1,100 L for SC/ST beneficiaries).
